notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four experience counters.
You control up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{R}{R}.
description:
Cast Frantic Search by paying {U}.
Holding priority, activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{R}{R}.
Cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {R}{R}, creating a copy of Frantic Search and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the Frantic Search copy, causing you to loot twice and untap up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
